content_text: You’ll find many scenes using strongly colored lighting scattered throughout Roger’s films — immediately I’m thinking the deep blue-lit scene with Daniel Craig in his car in Shanghai in “Skyfall” and the bar scene in “Sicario”. They are tend to be logically motivated while supporting the emotions of the scene.
